map.新品上市前测算需要卖多少件才能不亏，支撑定价与产能决策。: Before launching a new product, work out how many units must sell to avoid a loss, supporting pricing and capacity decisions.
map.降价谈判或促销评估时，测算单价下调后保本销量的变化。: In price negotiations or promotion appraisals, model how a lower unit price shifts the break-even volume.
map.固定成本上升（如涨租）时，重新测算保本点以调整经营目标。: When fixed costs rise (a rent increase, say), recompute the break-even point to reset operating targets.
